incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT alert — p99 latency breach on continuous-batching runtime (us-west-2). Metric: contbatch-server-3.p99 = 12.4s (> SLO 5s). Streaming stalls and tail jitter observed. Auto-escalation to #eng-oncall triggered.
sara: seeing the same on dashboards. tail spikes correlate with mixed-seq requests hitting the contbatch path. p95 around 700ms but p99 huge.
matt: any customer-facing errors?
sara: a handful of streaming stalls reported — streaming frames time out then resume. 3 customer sessions observed in logs with >10s stalls (tickets: TCK-1829, TCK-1831). No 5xx count spike yet.
jess: attaching quick traces: `trace/contbatch/2026-03-15/slot-7` shows KV cache thrash during long sequences, batcher holds hetero requests and scheduling waits.
sara: root message: it looks like large-seqlen requests (~6k tokens) are being co-batched with many short chat requests. when big request enters, scheduler pads and delays dispatch to fill batch => long tail.
kai: can we fast-shed large requests from contbatch and route to streaming-only path?
matt: streaming-only path is lower throughput for long seqs — might increase cost but reduce tail. good short-term mitigation.
sara: mitigation plan I propose: 1) lower contbatch.max_batch_size from 256 -> 96 on affected pool, 2) enable scheduler.fair_share=true for contbatch-worker group, 3) set routing rule to send requests with seq_len > 1024 to fallback-model: longseq-optimized.
jess: +1 on fair_share. also suggest enabling prefix-KV retention bypass to avoid eviction thrashing for warmed long sessions.
kai: runbook commands?
sara: running now: `kubectl set env deploy/contbatch-worker -n inference BATCH_MAX=96 --record`
sara: `curl -X POST https://console.internal/route/update -d '{"rule":"seq_len>1024","dest":"longseq-optimized","priority":15}'`
incident-bot: deploybot: started rollout for contbatch-worker config change (deploy/contbatch-worker) by sara at 3632100065. Rollout id: r-8123.
jess: observed immediate reduction in batch build latency on pod-17; p99 dropped from 12.4s -> 4.8s on that pod within 45s.
matt: progressively roll change across pool. i'll monitor backpressure.
sara: enabling fair_share flag now: `redis-cli -h config apply scheduler:fair_share true` (config service).
kai: note: fair_share may increase leftover small batch throughput issues for very low-latency paths. we'll watch p95.
sara: customer-impact note: we throttled large requests temporarily — long-running customer job (acct acme-data) slowed. raised support ticket for them and emailed compliance.
matt: confirming, error injection: none. Affected region only us-west-2 contbatch pool.
jess: logs show a KV eviction storm at t=3632100020 across pods 11-19 causing cache miss penalty ~1.2s per request. after BATCH_MAX change eviction rate down 70%.
sara: still seeing a few streaming stalls in traces; suspect preemption + pad logic. switching preemptive-shedding on: `console set preemptive_shed=true --target=contbatch-pool-usw2`
incident-bot: ops-alert: preemptive_shedding toggle applied by sara (rollout r-8124) at 3632100150.
kai: good. can someone post the exact metrics we want visible in the incident doc? p95, p99, streaming stall count, KV eviction rate, customer sessions impacted.
matt: I'll create incident issue INC-2026-347 and include links + short mitigation notes.
sara: current live numbers (after mitigations): contbatch.p95=0.68s, p99=3.9s, streaming-stalls=7/min (was 22/min), kv-evict-rate=0.9% (was 3.1%).
jess: recommend follow-ups: 1) permanent route for seq_len>1024 to longseq runtime, 2) scheduling fairness tests under synthetic mixed workloads, 3) tuning pad threshold and batch window heuristic to avoid waiting for large pads.
kai: add test: synthetic replay with 5% 6k-token requests interspersed with 95% chat-20 requests for 1h. test on staging contbatch with current knobs.
matt: noted. I'll own the follow-up ticket for scheduler simulation and acceptance criteria. assigning to jess + kai.
sara: handoff to next oncall @matt — i'm staying until 3632100600 but will handoff summary: mitigations applied (BATCH_MAX lowered, fair_share on, preemptive_shedding enabled, seq_len routing rule added). customer impact: 2 high-priority sessions slowed, support notified.
matt: taking handoff. will watch the region and escalate to infra if CPU spikes from smaller batches. set an alert to roll back if p95 > 1s for more than 10m.
jess: adding a note: we should investigate KV cache growth pattern — possible memory pressure leading to eviction loop. I'll dump memstats tonight.
kai: creating replay job now. link: https://ci.internal/job/contbatch-mixedseq-replay/363210.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation tracker updated. Status: partial-mitigated. INC-2026-347 created by matt. Handoff: sara -> matt.
sara: thumbs up — leave any unanswered action items in INC-2026-347. i'll follow-up on customer comms. :thumbsup:
matt: will post postmortem draft tomorrow with timeline, root cause hypothesis (batching + pad amplification + KV thrash), and remediation plan.
jess: quick note for postmortem: include sample traces and the `kubectl describe pod` dumps from pods 11-19.
kai: thanks all. ping me if the replay shows regression.
incident-bot: Reminder: oncall follow-up checklist due in 24h.
matt: closing thread here, monitoring.
